hypothesis: After source-only syntax diversification, bounded observation prefixes with retained cleanup may expose smaller complete defect witnesses across all 17 trials. This phase measures construction and native behavior before any semantic gate.
selection: First eight distinct normalized syntax/scope identities per trial in the existing fixed source ranking. Sort chosen parents by selection rank then trial. Identity is an allocation heuristic, not semantic equivalence.
source_pool: 1438 historical controlled failures. Only pool membership and source artifacts participate; native failure text, model decisions and evaluation labels do not.
execution: Try prefix rank round-robin over all parents; stop each parent at its first controlled failure or failed/unavailable source control. Retain original whole-test fallback. Verify complete emitted syntax before each run.
limitations: The pool was already generated and executed historically. This is not a cold end-to-end cost.
No valid-detector count can be inferred from failing tests alone.
All trials remain development-seen. The 17 denominator includes 14 distinct tasks.
Prefix construction and source finalizer recognition remain bounded.
A whole-test semantic gate still needs authorized provider access; this local phase does not bypass it.
